elements.finding: One control changes the active project and manages local project files.

elements.element: Project / Scenario / Version / draft identity in command bar
elements.finding: Compact lineage context should remain global and human-readable.
Header is a read-only summary; changes remain in Setup/Inventory.

elements.element: Run Sector / Evaluate Network primary action
elements.finding: Explicit compute is appropriate and must remain tied to active task/context.

elements.element: Plan / Simulate / Analyze / Review stage rail
elements.finding: High-level navigation only; chooser owns stage-specific tools.
Shows tool availability, result badges, and attention cues.
Correct owner for active workflow; Results/History are task-owned review surfaces.

elements.element: Planning mode, technology, TX power, ray count, radius, azimuth, beam width
elements.finding: Plan inputs, not selected-entity details.

elements.element: Selected cell count and selected cluster membership
elements.finding: Selection changes the optimizer/RF input and can invalidate current results.

elements.element: Scenario list, Save Version, branch, duplicate, Continue
elements.finding: Embedded in Setup even though primary role is managing durable workspace lineage.
Selection inspects immutable history; Continue/Branch are explicit actions that create a new draft/lineage.
Run selection is history browsing and does not activate the current plan.
Run source facts should be compact; hashes/fingerprints are tertiary.

elements.element: Pareto solution selector and objective detail
elements.finding: Candidate selection changes only which retained optimization alternative is inspected.
Inspector should be read-only and link to Inventory for edits.
Point detail belongs to a selected result sample; source Run/freshness stays attached.
Building AGL/terrain/source context is selected-object detail and must retain diagnostic-only boundary.
Changes visible layers/focus only; it must not change serving cell, cluster membership, or inspector identity.

elements.element: Map layer toggles and aggregate legend
elements.finding: Legend explains a whole layer; inspector explains one selected sample/entity.
State must identify source Run and never imply recomputation.

elements.element: Stale toast/map prompt and async progress
elements.finding: Explain what changed and provide one safe next action.

elements.element: Dataset quality, buildings, POI demand, residential count
elements.finding: Data confidence is useful planning context; QA should be compact, provenance belongs in details.
These facts do not deserve equal weight with planning data quality/counts.
Explicit dataset management; incompatible results must remain stale/unavailable.
Evidence workflow can explicitly propose a plan correction; not generic dataset metadata.
Developer/admin instructions should not be primary ordinary planning UI.
Create/export first; retained artifact and integrity detail remain inspectable.
Always pair icon/color with readable reason and next step.

mixed_responsibility_findings.recommendation: Move Scenario/Version management to a dedicated Plan > Scenarios tool; keep Setup for current plan inputs.
Keep canonical actions visible and give independent Validation, Materials, and Reflection research workflows one-at-a-time internal subviews.
Keep history master/detail inside Review; group full provenance and public solution detail under the selected Run, not a global inspector.
Lead with result kind, freshness/source, score/feasibility, and primary objective values; progressively disclose metrics/configuration/evidence.
Lead with compact planning data and data quality; details/QA/provenance/dev commands are secondary or tertiary; keep measurement calibration explicitly separate.
Separate Inspect from Select when clicking a cell can change active RF source/cluster membership.
